page_annotations: The page is otherwise blank ruled paper. Ghosting across the ruled area is show-through from the other side of the leaf.
There is a small stray pencil stroke near the top at approximately [1340,600], with no text.
The right portion of the canvas beyond the gutter (x≈3200+) shows facing fol. 244 fragments ('c. 4…', 'see s. Viṣṇu…', 'd.' shelfmarks, ticks, arrows). These were not transcribed as target records.
The leftward arrow at approximately [3290,3545] lies on fol. 244 at the level of the b004 entry.
unresolved_relationships: The exact insertion point of r001 in the fol. 244 sequence is unconfirmed. It is probably near the Vāstuyāgatattva / Vāstupradīpa entries.
The relation of the pencil letter/slash marks (r003–r005) to entries on this page or fol. 244 is undetermined.

coverage.finding: The folio number '243' with a superscript 'b' is in the top-left corner at about [380,315]. The record is correct.

Pencil 'ṅ/ ś/ ā/' at about x 2660–2960, y 1370–1590. The first letter shows a mark above an 'n'-like form, so 'ṅ' is plausible but not certain. The record already flags this. No attachment to an entry on this page is visible.

A single pencil letter with a long slash at about [2870,2480]. A dot is visible below the letter, which favours 'ṣ'. The candidate's literal 'ṣ/' presents this as resolved, while its own uncertainty says otherwise. The literal is marked as uncertain below.

The two-line ink entry is verified in the native tiles. Line 1 runs from '√ b. 95 (7)c.' to 'ff. 1-30, inc. (foll. by five leaves'. Line 2 runs from 'of scraps.' to 'parīkṣitām', followed by 'n.d.: 35: 5/6 f: Beng.' at the right. The left-margin tick is a thin faint stroke at about x 340. 'five' could also be read as 'fire', and the record keeps this uncertain. No cancellation is visible.
A hand-drawn loop encloses '(Begins Tatrādau prāguktadīpavarttyā[?] parīkṣitām' and closes after 'parīkṣitām'. The '[?]' is written in the source. The incipit is correctly grouped with r001.
Pencil 'ā/' with 'ś/' below and to its right, at about x 2720–2890, y 3895–4200. The record is correct and the marks are unattached.

A very faint trace at about x 2060–2530, y 3940–4030, with dots to the left. A possible 'sāt…' is visible, followed by a few more faint letters. It is treated as illegible, possibly erased writing. Show-through cannot be excluded.

changes.reason: A dot below the letter is visible, so 'ṣ' is the likelier reading. The dot could still be a stray mark, so 's' remains possible. Following the inventory and the record's own uncertainty note, the literal should not present the reading as resolved.

unresolved.issue: The attachment to the fol. 244 sequence rests on a leftward arrow on fol. 244, level with the 'd. 775 (7) Vāstupradīpa' / '√c. 384 (3) Vāstuyāgatattva' entries. The inventory note says fol. 244 has a 'matching …5:5/6 f: Beng' fragment. That fragment is most likely this page's own text appearing at the edge of the adjacent photograph, so it is not independent evidence.
unresolved.next_check: Examine fol. 244 at native resolution to confirm the arrow's target and whether any insertion mark corresponds to it.

unresolved.issue: The field role of '35' in 'n.d.: 35: 5/6 f: Beng.' is not stated on the page. The fol. 243 and fol. 244 entries follow a 'n.d.: N : N : script' pattern, but this page does not resolve the role of '35'. The assignment of '5/6' to the lines field also remains uncertain.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with the catalogue's stated field conventions, if they are given elsewhere.

unresolved.issue: The purpose of the pencil letter-slash marks is unknown. Similar marks ('ā/', 's/') appear in the outer margins of fol. 243 and fol. 244, so these may relate to facing-page entries. This is unverified.
unresolved.next_check: Check the margin marks on the neighbouring leaves for a systematic keying pattern.

review.boundary_review: The target page ends at the gutter at about x 3180–3220. Beyond it are fragments of fol. 244: 'c. 4…', 'see s. Viṣṇu…', 'd.' shelfmarks, ticks, a rightward arrow at about y 2140 and a leftward arrow at about [3290,3545]. None of these is transcribed as a target record. The leftward arrow is noted only as relationship evidence. Show-through is visible throughout the ruled area and was not transcribed.

region_review.top: Folio number 243b, plus a small stray pencil stroke at about [1340,600] with no text. The stroke is noted in page_annotations. A dot near the top edge at about x 3050 has no text.
region_review.middle: Only the pencil marks b002 and b003 and scattered stray dots are present. The rest is show-through.
region_review.bottom: The b004/b005 entry, the b006 marks and the faint b901 trace. Below about y 4200 the page is blank ruled paper down to its bottom edge at about y 4820.
region_review.left_margin: Only the faint tick before 'b. 95'. No other marginal writing.
region_review.right_margin: Pencil marks b002, b003 and b006 lie toward the right side. The text beyond the gutter belongs to fol. 244.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions or cancellations were found. The loop around the incipit lies on the second line of the entry.
